caseNameFull: Sims v. Moore, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Fla. In light of the recent amendments to §922.10 of the Florida Statutes (providing that capital prisoners will be executed by lethal injection unless they affirmatively elect execution by electrocution), and the Florida Supreme Court’s recent conclusion that those amendments do not violate Art. X, § 9, of the Florida Constitution, Sims v. State, 754 So. 2d 657 (2000), certiorari denied.
